output.title: Cloudflare DNS01 fix: solver configuration not shown
output.content: The fix restores DNS01 issuance on Cloudflare after a breaking Cloudflare API change. It matters only if an issuer uses a Cloudflare DNS01 solver. The environment summary shows no Issuer or ClusterIssuer manifests, so solvers are not visible. Check the issuers for a Cloudflare DNS01 solver.
